text:
maria: Proposal: when users approve items from a regression diff, show a non-modal toast with 'Undo' and add a small persistent pill in the scorecard header that links to the diff. keeps users in context.
kevin: can you drop the figma link?
maria: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/Bulk-approve-pill-toast (mock). Top-right toast, small animation, pill in scorecard header that reads '12 approved' and is focusable.
asha: accessibility notes: do NOT move focus to the row on toast. Use role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" for the toast. Pill should be focusable and aria-describedby should point to a hidden SR node containing score delta text like 'Scorecard: 3 regressions introduced, 0 resolved.'
jessica: UX: pill should include a tiny link icon and tooltip 'View regression diff'. toast copy: 'Approved 12 prompt sets. Undo' and timeout 6s; Undo remains keyboard-focusable until dismissed.
kevin: implementation note: we'll update the list in-place and batch server calls by 50. emit analytics events approval.bulk and scorecard.update. progressive visual count for large batches (e.g., 'Approving 120 of 300...') but only announce final result to SRs.
maria: acceptance criteria: (1) toast announced via aria-live, (2) no focus trap, (3) Undo keyboard accessible, (4) scorecard pill focusable & links to regression diff, (5) analytics events emitted, (6) SR tests for final announce and undo flow.
asha: SR test steps to include: select items, trigger approve, assert SR reads 'Approved X prompt sets. Press Undo to revert.', Tab to Undo -> Enter to revert -> assert SR announces 'Reverted X prompt sets.' include Esc path returning focus to bulk action toolbar.
deploy-bot: UAT deployed at feature/bulk-approve-pill-toast for testing.
jessica: :thumbsup: tagging @kevin to implement and @asha to write SR tests. will review after UAT pass.
